tools.name: search_coffee
tools.title: Search the coffee on this page
tools.description: Search Northwind's range by name, origin, roast, tasting note or use (espresso, filter, decaf, gift) and return price, size and stock.

query.description: What the shopper is after, e.g. 'fruity pour-over' or 'decaf'

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.title: Add a coffee to the cart
tools.description: Put a bag of one of Northwind's coffees in this visitor's cart, by SKU or by name.

sku.description: The SKU or the coffee's name

tools.name: view_cart
tools.title: Read the cart
tools.description: What is in the cart right now, with the subtotal, the delivery charge and the total.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.title: Where is my order
tools.description: THE tool for any order or delivery question — 'where is my order', tracking, ETA. Call this FIRST for that ask, even when the visitor is signed out: a not-signed-in refusal is the expected, correct outcome and is what shows the sign-in card. Never substitute contact_northwind for this just because it is signed out. Once signed in, returns where one of the customer's orders is, with carrier, tracking number and expected delivery date. Answers only for the customer signed in on this page.

tools.name: start_return
tools.title: Start a return
tools.description: Open a return for one item on one of the signed-in customer's orders and report the refund and what happens next.

orderNumber.description: The order the item came in

sku.description: The SKU or name of the item going back

reason.description: Why, in the customer's own words
